text:
Emma: Quick plan 12/10 09:00PT  Kick off a tiny 'admit + priority' flow for preview signups. Objectives: 1) fast triage of intent, 2) capture security & timeline, 3) route top accounts to 1:1 20-min slots. Draft form: https://redwood.ai/forms/admit-priority-v1

Dylan: Keep it 3 fields: "main use case", "target launch (weeks)", "security: none/KMS/HSM/enterprise". Add a free text "biggest blocker" field.

Sara_prod: I want a field for "primary metric" so we can map to ML/infra signals later (latency, throughput, cost, accuracy).

Kevin_ops: Note on capacity: we have 6x 20-min onboarding slots/week for Dec 10-24. Suggest scoring threshold for 1:1 and fallthrough to cohort office hour (Fri 2pm PT). Also add a flag if they require dedicated IPs or peering.

Dylan: Prototype score: `score = min(15, floor(log10(monthly_calls+1))*2) + (security!='none')*4 + (launch_weeks<6)*3`. >11 = 1:1 invite. I'll add a column in the export.

formbot: form "admit-priority-v1" published by emma_cs at 2024-12-10T16:05:00Z -> https://redwood.ai/forms/admit-priority-v1

Emma: Action items: @dylan_se run initial join query + drop CSV to Coda by EOD; @sara_prod add mapping doc for primary_metric -> product tags; @kevin_ops confirm overflow plan (cohort cadence). I'll draft invite language.

Dylan: Running query now. SQL snippet I'll use: `SELECT acct, company, sum(api_calls) as monthly_calls, tags FROM accounts WHERE created_at > now()-interval '60 days' GROUP BY acct,company,tags ORDER BY monthly_calls DESC LIMIT 400;`

Kevin_ops: Confirm overflow: cohort office hours Fri 2pm PT, and we can scale 1:1s by pulling in a product rep if >8/week.

Sara_prod: Added metric mapping doc to Coda: https://coda.io/d/admit-priority#MetricMapping. Will monitor for common blockers and share weekly.

Emma: Great — I'll send the first wave of nudges tomorrow AM for top scorers. Will ping when invites go out. Thanks :raised_hands:
